settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Prepare – Cleanse the client’s skin using our Mangosteen Cleanser and apply a generous layer of Restore or Renu conductive gel.
  2. Select Settings – Power on the MyoLift 600 and adjust the intensity level based on client comfort and treatment goals.
  3. Lift & Glide – Use slow, controlled
    movements over targeted areas such as the forehead, cheeks, jawline, and
    neck, following professional guidelines.
  4. Pinch & Hold – Apply the probes to areas prone to sagging for deeper muscle activation and definition.
  5. Finish – Remove any remaining gel and apply our Anti-Aging Serum or Revital-C Serum for
    enhanced hydration and results.
  6. Recommended Use – Incorporate into professional facial treatments as needed, with customized frequency based on client goals and skin type

Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What makes the Myolift 600 plus a professional only device?
settings.text1:
The higher intensity, with the range of 175 to 650 microamps. The higher
intensity will give a stronger lift and is made for the professional to deliver the optimal results.
You also will have access to a training portal with video tutorials as well as other materials to
help you. We also offer free webinars that you can attend and you can ask questions with
the educator. There are also educators that are always available to answer any questions
you may have.
settings.title2: What waveforms are on the Myolift 600 plus?
settings.text2:
The Myolift 600 plus comes with three distinct waveforms.
Lymph- has a specifically designed pumping waveform to stimulate the lymphatic system
and promote drainage.
Long- Relaxes those muscles that become tight from overuse. Targets fine lines and
wrinkles to help smooth the skin.
Short: Re-educates and strengthens facial muscles, providing lift and improved tone
settings.title3: What are the benefits of Lymphatic drainage when combined with microcurrent?
settings.text3:
Combining lymphatic drainage with microcurrent therapy amplifies the
benefits of both treatments, offering a range of advantages for skin health and overall
wellness.
Enhanced Detoxification: Lymphatic drainage helps remove toxins and waste products
from the body. When paired with microcurrent therapy, which stimulates cellular activity, the
detoxification process becomes more efficient, leading to clearer skin and improved overall
health.
Reduced Puffiness and Inflammation: The gentle movements of lymphatic drainage help
to reduce fluid retention and swelling. When combined with microcurrent therapy, this effect
is intensified, leading to a more sculpted facial appearance and reduced inflammation,
particularly in the under-eye and jawline areas.
Improved Skin Tone and Texture: Microcurrent therapy promotes collagen and elastin
production while lymphatic drainage enhances circulation. Together, they improve skin tone
and texture, leading to a more youthful and radiant complexion.
Increased Oxygen and Nutrient Delivery: Microcurrent therapy boosts blood circulation,
which, when combined with lymphatic drainage, enhances the delivery of oxygen and
nutrients to skin cells. This results in healthier skin that appears revitalized and rejuvenated.
settings.title4: Can I customize my treatments using the Myolift 600 plus?
settings.text4:
Yes, microcurrent can be used as an add-on and you can combine microcurrent
with other modalities to give a “red carpet” treatment especially for a special engagement
when you want a lifted and glowing result. You are also able to target different areas of the
face to provide a customized treatment. Microcurrent will compliment many modalities as it is
very healing to the skin. To get the best results, we recommend you do microcurrent in a
series.
settings.title5: How long does it take to see results?
settings.text5:
Microcurrent is best done in a series. Much like going to the gym, consistency will
yield the best results. Microcurrent is cumulative and depending on the age of your client
the number of a series will vary. A series consists of having the client come in twice a week
for either 6, 10 or 15 treatments. You then will do maintenance to maintain the lift having the
client come in once a month.
